requirements.requirement: A change shall not become executable until all mandatory approvals, prerequisites, windows and policy obligations are satisfied.
requirements.invariant: Grant only from exact qualified snapshot; any unknown prerequisite fails closed.

requirements.requirement: Execution grants shall be scoped, expiring, non-transferable authority artifacts and shall not outlive revocation of required authorization.
requirements.invariant: Current principal/auth policy is checked at start and consequential boundaries.

requirements.requirement: Unknown authorization, unknown change revision, unknown target identity or unknown critical recovery eligibility shall fail closed for new consequential effects.
requirements.invariant: Critical unknown is never treated as allow.
